# Spec: Review the right audit trail

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/review-the-right-audit-trail.md)

**Start:** `/operations/right-audit`  
**Persona:** An operator looking into a refused call  
**Goal:** See which right checks the API allowed or refused, and narrow the list to the refusals.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Read the trail | Both checks are listed, the allowed one and the forbidden one. |
| 2 | Show only the refusals | Only the forbidden check remains. |

Source: `e2e/journeys.ts` (journey `review-the-right-audit-trail`). Each expected result is asserted by the step's `run` function.
